context.transcript:
Richard, I'm glad I ran into you.
About the launch party for our new baseball video game, did you confirm the menu with the caterers yet?
Yes, I just called the catering company this morning, and their manager says everything is all set.
Good.
And you had the idea of having the servers wear baseball hats to go along with the theme of the party.
Is that okay with the catering manager, too?
She said it'd be fine, but we'd have to provide the hats.
That reminds me I need to call her back to find out how many servers are working so I can make sure to have enough hats.
context.transcript_translation:
理查德，很高兴偶遇你。
关于我们新的棒球视频游戏的发布派对，你和餐饮公司确认菜单了吗？
是的，我今天早上刚给餐饮公司打了电话，他们的经理说一切都安排好了。
很好。
而且你提出了让服务员戴上棒球帽的想法，以配合派对的主题。
这在餐饮经理那里也行吗？
她说没问题，但我们需要提供帽子。
提醒我了，我需要回电给她，问一下有多少服务员，这样我才能确保有足够的帽子。
